_comment_process: node directly, not `pnpm start` — the same wrapper bug that cost 46 minutes of billing
on 2026-08-29 (see tmbilling-worker.json for the full timeline).
pm2 supervises the pid it spawns. With script=pnpm that pid was a launcher which exits
immediately on SIGINT, so pm2 declared the app stopped and treekilled the real node
process underneath — mid-request, and long before kill_timeout could apply.
The API strands no queue locks, so this was never going to cause the outage the worker
did. It fails more quietly instead: in-flight HTTP requests cut off mid-response, and a
kill_timeout that has never once been honoured. Fixed here because it is the same
defect, and leaving one of the two configs wrong is how it grows back.
